title: Baicalin attenuates lipopolysaccharide-induced intestinal inflammatory injury via suppressing PARP1-mediated NF-kappaB and NLRP3 signalling pathway.
authors: Lu, Qirong; Wang, Nan; Wen, Defeng; Guo, Pu; Liu, Yu; Fu, Shulin; Ye, Chun; Wu, Zhongyuan; Qiu, Yinsheng
journal: Toxicon : official journal of the International Society on Toxinology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄苓苷通过靶向PARP1抑制NF-κB和NLRP3通路缓解肠道炎症，虽含分子对接但核心是炎症信号通路与药物机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Bacterial lipopolysaccharide (LPS) exposure is a key inducer of intestinal inflammatory injury in weaned piglets, resulting in decreased growth performance of pigs and causing severe economic losses to the swine industry; however, the mechanism of intestinal inflammatory injury is still unclear. Baicalin is one of the main active ingredients extracted from the natural plant Scutellaria baicalensis that has biological functions, including anti-inflammatory activity. The aim of this study is to investigate the effect and mechanism of baicalin intervention on intestinal inflammatory injury caused by bacterial LPS exposure. In the present study, network pharmacology, molecular docking and DARTS results identified that baicalin has the potential to target PARP1, thereby potentially regulating a series of inflammation-related pathways, including the MAPK, NF-kappaB and Toll-like receptor signalling pathways, which play the role of antagonizing LPS-induced intestinal inflammatory injury. Further application of the LPS-induced IPEC-J2 cell model validated the finding that baicalin could alleviate LPS-induced intestinal inflammatory injury by inhibiting the PARP1-mediated NF-kappaB and NLRP3 signalling pathway. These findings demonstrate that baicalin can regulate the expression of PARP1 and that PARP1 has the potential to serve as an effective therapeutic target in the LPS-induced intestinal inflammatory injury.
abstract_zh: 细菌脂多糖（LPS）暴露是断奶仔猪肠道炎症损伤的关键诱因，导致猪生长性能下降，给养猪业造成严重经济损失；然而，肠道炎症损伤的机制仍不清楚。黄芩苷是从天然植物黄芩（Scutellaria baicalensis）中提取的主要活性成分之一，具有包括抗炎活性在内的多种生物功能。本研究旨在探讨黄芩苷干预对细菌LPS暴露引起的肠道炎症损伤的作用及其机制。在本研究中，网络药理学、分子对接和DARTS结果鉴定出黄芩苷具有靶向PARP1的潜力，从而可能调控一系列炎症相关通路，包括MAPK、NF-kappaB和Toll样受体信号通路，发挥拮抗LPS诱导的肠道炎症损伤的作用。进一步应用LPS诱导的IPEC-J2细胞模型验证了黄芩苷可通过抑制PARP1介导的NF-kappaB和NLRP3信号通路来缓解LPS诱导的肠道炎症损伤。这些发现表明，黄芩苷能够调节PARP1的表达，且PARP1有潜力作为LPS诱导的肠道炎症损伤的有效治疗靶点。
